blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — House impeachment prosecution team adviser and spokesperson Ace Barbers said on Saturday that, in his personal view, the allegation of unexplained wealth against Vice President Sara Duterte was the strongest among the three impeachment articles being pursued by the prosecution.
